feed.title: Guardana notes
feed.subtitle: Articles from the Guardana maintainers about AI security verification.

entry.title: 1.0.0 release gate evidence for engineering criteria (#144)
entry.summary: The engineering tests passed on fb9ab309 for 1.0.0; items without their own tests are tracked in #215.

entry.title: Security runbook drill (#142)
entry.summary: The maintainer exercised private intake, coordination, a fix, TestPyPI release and withdrawal, disclosure on paper, and cleanup on a made-up report.

entry.title: Retrieval pilot: poisoned document and tenant filter (#139)
entry.summary: The fixed pilot passed; a broken tenant filter failed the tenancy check, and a model obeying a document failed the poisoned-document check.

entry.title: Regression loop with a redacted regression (#140)
entry.summary: A redacted recording retained the regression, failed regrading and the CI comparison, and supplied a regression pair after the question was rewritten.

entry.title: Collector recovery runbooks (#143)
entry.summary: The proof upgraded a database created by 0.41.0, checked rollback and readiness, and restored a Compose backup in place and onto a new volume.

entry.title: Customization through published extension points (#141)
entry.summary: The customization proof passed all 12 steps using the published reference pack in a fresh environment with the network cut.

entry.title: Clean-install offline first run (#138)
entry.summary: The offline first-run proof passed all 12 cells across Linux, macOS and Windows, each with 14 of 14 steps.

entry.title: Catching tenant leaks and poisoned documents before release
entry.summary: A reference retrieval app shows how to check tenant answers and document instructions, save the result, and rerun it with clear coverage limits.
